Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite asset sheet for the dark gothic action RPG Returns from Darkness, collection Ashes of the Return. Exactly SIX distinct isolated equipment designs in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid on a truly transparent RGBA background. Large landscape master, ideally 3072 x 2048 pixels, each cell at least 512 pixels, full object inside its own cell with 12 percent clear margin. No item crosses cell boundaries, no cast shadow outside the silhouette, no shared platform. Read order left to right then top to bottom:
1. short soot-black iron sword, chipped silver edge, thorn crossguard with a cracked ember-red garnet, leather grip
2. long two-edged weathered steel sword, broad fuller, raven-wing iron crossguard, small dark ruby, torn black grip
3. compact single-headed iron axe with charred ashwood shaft and crescent silver edge
4. one-handed iron mace whose heavy flanged head resembles a cracked cathedral bell, worn leather grip
5. small recurved dark yew bow with iron thorn fittings, taut string and ember-red leather wraps
6. gnarled dark wood short staff with iron-bound crooked head cradling one red ember stone
Original grounded gothic fantasy designs, weathered dark iron and charcoal leather, silver worn edges, restrained dark ember-red accent only, detailed materials and distinct silhouette readable when reduced into classic isometric inventory slots. Pre-rendered three-quarter game sprite look, consistent high-angle soft light from upper left, each weapon diagonally lower-left to upper-right; shields and armor facing three-quarter toward viewer; small jewelry large enough to fill its own cell. All tips, bowstrings, straps, edges fully included. No people, no text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no logos, no watermark, no scenery, no checkerboard painted into image. Keep art cohesive with a dark iron gargoyle HUD and original Diablo atmosphere. Do not make bright flashy effects or gold-rich decoration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original production inventory sprite sheet for Returns from Darkness, Ashes of the Return. Exactly SIX isolated gothic equipment assets on TRUE TRANSPARENT background in a 3-column x 2-row grid. Highest available landscape resolution. Every item must fit fully inside its equal rectangular cell, leave at least 15 percent clear transparent padding inside EVERY cell, especially at the central row and column boundaries. No overlap, no touching, no surroundings. Top row left to right, then bottom row:
1. worn charcoal leather torso armor with a short torn shoulder mantle, simple iron buckles and muted dark red lining, no person
2. dark stitched leather cuirass with asymmetric iron shoulder plates and thorn-shaped clasps, no person
3. weathered iron chainmail torso with narrow ribbed shoulder plates, dark red cloth lining and modest cathedral crest, no person
4. full dark iron gothic plate cuirass, interlocking fluted plates, pointed shoulders, subtle ember-red seams, empty armor without body
5. simple weathered open-face iron helmet, short brow ridge, leather cheek straps, small thorn engraving
6. closed gothic iron helmet with a narrow dark visor, short crown-like thorn spikes and tiny inset deep red gems
Grounded Diablo-like grim gothic pre-rendered 3D item art, charcoal leather and blackened weathered iron, fine worn silver edges, sparing deep ember-red cloth or small gems. Cohesive materials and realistic proportions. Empty torso armor, no body or mannequin. All six objects have comparable apparent size and complete readable silhouette, soft upper-left illumination, restrained contrast, no full-screen glow or painted shadows. No gold-rich fantasy ornament, text, numbers, labels, borders, logos or watermark. No background painted black; use real alpha transparency. These pieces will be individually cropped into high-quality inventory sprites.
